_note: Operation contracts (docs/combined_arms.md 6.1, 6.3-6.6, 3.5; phase D3, cg_brief queue item 3.2; Operations, FrontGrid). Each type: 'offer' (posted on the board now: D4 and D5 turn on theirs when they build their mechanics), 'base_pay' (6.5, before the rating's difficulty_pay, the employer tier's pay_mult and an employer's 'op_pay_mult'), 'days' (campaign days), 'h_hour' ('now', 'player': waits for the company to cross the line of departure, 'dawn': D5's beach landing), 'phases' (2-4: a name, the band whose far end is its phase 'line', 'limit_min', 'pay_share', the allied 'objectives' and the company's 'company_task'), the OOBs and the allied fires. A site selector ('at', or an entry of 'objectives'): {'site': module id, or '@town', '@hq', '@depth', '@fob'}, {'crossing': 'msr'|'route'|'ford'} (where that crossing meets the river), or {'band', 'types', 'max'} (the band's sites of those types, nearest the MSR first). Company task kinds: seize_site, keep_intact (a bridge span standing), hold_line ('hold_s' with the ground ours). OOB entries: 'kind' (a GroupBoard kind), 'groups' (a count, or [min, max]), 'men' a group, 'vehicles' (models; their crew from 'crew'), 'at' (a selector, else 'bands' to spread over), 'callsign', 'kit' (friendly: a Kits id; hostile: 'rifles', 'at', 'mg'), 'reserve' (held back as the side's reserve), 'wave' (friendly: arrives at the start edge this many minutes after H-hour). All Proposed.
_pay_note: 6.5: each phase pays its 'pay_share' of the completion pay (the pay less the advance) when it's done, with its bonuses and penalties (shares of that phase's pay): done in under 'fast_share' of its limit 'fast_bonus'; allied losses in it under 'low_losses_share' of the allied OOB 'low_losses_bonus'; 'coop_bonus' an allied ask answered in it (RequestBroker), up to 'coop_max'; no civilian casualty in it, contracts.json 'clean_bonus_share'; done past its limit 'late_penalty'; each friendly-fire incident in it 'ff_penalty' (and 'ff_rep' with the employer). Company vehicles (the motor pool's) lost on it are 'indemnity_share' reimbursed at the debrief. Reputation at the debrief: every phase done contracts.json 'rep_success', at least half 'rep_partial', fewer 'rep_fail'.
_run_note: The run in the zone (Operations): the clock and phases checked every 'tick_s'; the phase stalls (the operation stops, what's left unpaid) at side_command.json phase_fail_share x its limit. A seize_site is taken with no hostile left within its radius and one of ours there for 'seize_hold_s'; a site in a cell the allies hold by 'overrun_ratio' x its expected garrison's CP for the front's flip time, never visited by a player, is taken off-screen and the allies lose 'overrun_loss_share' of its garrison in men. 'crossed_m': past the start band's end by this, a player has crossed the line of departure. The OOB comes out 'spawn_men_frame' men a frame while the live caps (BigZoneStreaming) allow, enemy groups only once a player is within 'spawn_near_m' of them and none within 'spawn_far_m' or in sight; the enemy's reinforcements every 'reinforce_s' while a phase runs ('reinforce_men' a group, at most 'reinforce_max' a phase), on its side of the front at least spawn_far_m from every player, out of sight; an infiltrator team ('infiltrator_men') behind the front at most every 'infiltrator_s' with 'infiltrator_chance'. 'ied_count' IEDs on the MSR in the enemy's bands.
_front_note: The front (6.3, FrontGrid): 'cells' x 'cells' of 'cell_m' over the zone, recomputed every 'cycle_s'. A cell's presence by side is the CP of its groups (live and virtual, and the OOB still to come) in it and its eight neighbours, and the sites held in it (a site's expected garrison while it stands, 'site_cp' a man). A cell flips when the attacker's presence is 'flip_ratio' x the defender's for 'flip_s' and no defending garrison is left in it. At the start the friendly side holds the cells short of the start band's far end (and the sea). A phase done consolidates every cell short of its line with no enemy presence; the side's withdrawal gives back every cell past the last line it held with none of ours in it. Budget: 'budget_ms' a cycle for the zone's own load, 'budget_fight_ms' for a 160-group fight along the front, 'budget_gather_ms' for the whole cycle in the zone (gathering the presence and the sites, the overrun, the marker) (the test allows 'budget_slack' x each on a loaded machine).
_hud_note: The operation strip (OperationStrip, the HUD's top-right zone above the objectives): the operation's name, each phase's state, the current one's clock against its limit, the company's task and the front. Budget 'budget_ms' a refresh, every 'refresh_s'.
_support_note: D4/D5 (cg_brief queue item 3.3; docs/combined_arms.md 6.1, 6.4; OpSupport): what every type brings. Attached armour ('attached' on a type: model, count, callsign, 'seats' its allied crew fills, the rest left for players, 'kit', 'back_m' behind the start line): its orders checked every 'tick_s'; following the company's task it overwatches 'overwatch_short_m' short of the task's objective on our side; following a player it keeps within 'follow_m' at 'follow_gap_m'. Allied fires (a type's 'allied_fires' rounds by unit: mortar, artillery, naval; FireSupport's data 'allied_units'): the company's call is 'call_rounds' rounds, each unit 'call_cooldown_s' apart; the enemy's mortar 'enemy_rounds' at its commander's call. The trucks (an OOB entry's 'logistics': ammo or fuel) wait at the logistics point 'logistics_back_m' short of the last phase line taken and serve the allied and attached vehicles within 'serve_m' every 'serve_s' (fuel 'fuel_l' each). A type's 'medevac': how many of the company's medevac calls the employer's Dustoff flies. A type's 'prep': [{'phase', 'unit', 'rounds', 'max' targets, 'targets': 'objectives' (its enemy sites) or 'task', 'shell'}], fired as the phase begins. A type's 'region' ('coast', 'inland', 'any'), 'min_rep' (with the employer) and 'rate_bands' (the bands whose enemy sites count toward its rating; ['none'] for none) are its offer rules. Budgets: the support's tick 'budget_ms', each type's mechanic's 'mech_budget_ms', leaving out a tick that put something new in the world or planned a route (the test allows the front's budget_slack). The enemy's mortar stands 'enemy_mortar_back_m' back on its own side. All Proposed.

phased_invasion.name: Phased invasion
phased_invasion.brief: A four-phase invasion down the main supply route: the outposts, the crossing, the town, then the HQ and the depth target. The company fights beside the allied battlegroup with an Abrams section attached and its own task in each phase, and is paid as each phase is done.

company_task.text: Seize the checkpoint on the MSR at {grid}
Seize the bridge on the MSR at {grid}
Bonus: keep the bridge at {grid} standing
Clear the centre of the town at {grid}
Bonus: take the HQ's commander at {grid} alive

phased_invasion._commander: Phase 4's bonus (OpInvasion): the HQ's commander, out at the HQ as PL STEEL begins, taken alive with one of the company within secure_m of him.

armoured_thrust.name: Armoured thrust
armoured_thrust.brief: Ride with an allied armoured column down the axis through its blocking positions to the depth target, fast: the whole thrust has 45 minutes. The company is the column's infantry screen, a Bradley section attached to carry it.

company_task.text: Dismount and clear the AT threat at the blocking position at {grid}
Clear the AT threat in the town at {grid}

armoured_thrust._column: OpThrust: the whole thrust 'time_limit_min' from H-hour; the column 'gap_m' apart at 'kmh', halting 'halt_short_m' short of each blocking position not clear, going on once it is and every player is aboard (or after 'wait_mount_s'); a bypass 'bypass_side_m' to the side, leaving 'pocket_m' round the position to the enemy; the column lost past 'lost_share' of its vehicles fails it.

beach_landing.name: Beach landing
beach_landing.brief: Land from the LHD's well deck in AAVs at dawn, seize the beach exits and the harbour, then hold the beachhead against the counterattack.

company_task.text: Seize the left beach exit at {grid} and clear its bunkers
Seize the harbour's quays and sheds at {grid}
Hold the beachhead at {grid} for 15 minutes against the counterattack

beach_landing._landing: OpLanding: the deployment starts 'lead_s' before H-hour (the contract's 'hour' is first light less that); wave 1 ('company_aavs' with the company aboard, 'allied_aavs' with the wave-0 squads) out of the well deck from 'launch_s', 'stern_step_m' apart, wave 2 ('wave2_aavs', the wave-4 squads) 'wave2_s' later, each in its lane 'lane_m' apart, swimming in to 'beach_out_m' off the shore and up 'beach_in_m' onto it ('model'). Fires 'prep_s' before H-hour, 'prep_rounds' from each gun on up to 'prep_targets' known defences within 'defence_m' of the beach; smoke 'smoke_s' before it. Lost: 'lost_share' of wave 1's AAVs before the beach; the beachhead held by the enemy 'hold_fail_s' within 'hold_m'. The beach exits 'exit_gap_m' apart. 'counter': phase 3's waves from the enemy's 'axes' candidate approaches 'assembly_m' out, 'spread_deg' apart, beaten at 'beaten_share' of their men.

seize_crossing.name: Seizing a crossing
seize_crossing.brief: Take the concrete bridge intact and hold both banks while the armour crosses. Its charges are wired to a firing point on the far bank: kill its engineers, cut the wire or take the firing point before they see you.

company_task.text: Close on the bridge: take the checkpoint at {grid}
Hold the crossing at {grid} for 10 minutes while the armour crosses

seize_crossing._crossing: OpCrossing: 'charges' demo blocks under the middle span, wired to the firing point 'firing_back_m' past the bridge and 'firing_side_m' off the road; its team blows them 'fuse_s' after it sees a friendly within 'see_m' of the bridge (a line of sight every 'los_every_s'; before its men are out, anyone within 'pending_see_m' of the firing point), at once for a vehicle on the span. Stopped by its engineers down, the wire cut within 'cut_m' of a marked point, or the firing point seized (one of ours within 'seize_m', no enemy within 'seize_clear_m'). The banks 'bank_m' either side of the bridge; the armour crosses to 'cross_to_m' past it; lost: both banks (or the bridge down and every ford) held by the enemy 'hold_fail_s' within 'hold_m'. 'fallback_carve_m': the blast when no charge is left to fire. 'counter' as the beach landing's.

hold_town.name: Holding a town
hold_town.brief: The town has just been taken. The company is its garrison with an allied platoon, two Bradleys and a mortar section: ten minutes to prepare (dig in, site the guns, six pieces of field defences), then hold the centre against two or three waves.

company_task.text: Prepare the defence of the town at {grid}: dig in, site the guns, place the defences
Hold the town centre at {grid} against the counterattack

hold_town._town: OpTown: the town 'taken_m' round its centre is ours at the start (its garrisons gone). The defence budget: 'budget' pieces ('pieces': name, size in m, colour), each within 'radius_m' of the centre, 'gap_m' from another, while phase 1 runs. A piece is seen by a live enemy within 'seen_m' with a line of sight (checked every 'seen_every_s', at most 'rays_max' rays). The waves ('counter', from 'axes' approaches 'assembly_m' out, 'spread_deg' apart); won with every wave beaten (down to 'beaten_share' of its men) after 'min_hold_s', or the task's hold_s with the centre ours; lost when the enemy holds 'centre_m' round the centre 'hold_fail_s' with none of ours.
